query: Which mixed‑methods integration model (convergent, explanatory sequential, or exploratory) will we adopt and how will we produce joint displays and integration rules?

response.query: Which mixed‑methods integration model (convergent, explanatory sequential, or exploratory) will we adopt and how will we produce joint displays and integration rules?
response.answer: We will adopt the explanatory sequential mixed-methods integration model. Joint displays will be created using matrix tables, and integration rules will be based on comparing quantitative and qualitative findings.
